reserveReview.rationale: Fresh capture from the issuer-run reserve API on 2026-09-04 reported $19,855,565.93014987 of collateral; companion overview timestamp 2026-09-04T17:48:54.371Z. Grouping the 17 chain-level positions by stablecoin family yields AUSD 25.2901331784%, sUSDS 23.6406111204%, CELO 19.8880648425%, USDT/USDT0 11.1910668211%, EUROP 5.8495797572%, EURC/axlEUROC 5.7192251470%, USDC/axlUSDC 4.2423024173%, stETH 3.1196575688%, and ETH/WETH 1.0593591473%, normalized to 100%; WBTC is a zero-weight dust row and is omitted. Each tracked stablecoin exposure has an exact collateral edge; CELO, stETH, and ETH remain explicit exogenous collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-run Mento Reserve API capture dated 2026-09-04, grouped by stablecoin family; USDm is reserve-backed under Mento's documented model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every positive reserve API category is either linked to its tracked stablecoin family or explicitly dispositioned as an exogenous cryptoasset.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
ETH is identified external cryptoasset collateral (plain ETH on Ethereum plus the WETH residual on Celo, merged under the live adapter's ETH identity), not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
